description: Pine Tree Legal Assistance provides free civil legal help across Maine. Intake determines whether the organization can advise you or accept further work on the case.
introduction: Pine Tree Legal Assistance provides free civil legal help across Maine. Intake determines whether the organization can advise you or accept further work on the case.

who: Eligibility depends on income, assets, funding rules, the legal issue and conflicts of interest.

The program handles civil issues such as housing and benefits; it does not take criminal, traffic or personal injury matters. General family-law calls are not accepted, with certain abuse-related matters using advocacy referrals.
sections.get: Help may include advice or accepted representation. A request alone does not mean an attorney has agreed to handle the case.
sections.docs: Keep notices, court papers and deadlines beside you. Prepare names of the parties, contact information and household financial details. Explain a safe contact method if the issue involves abuse.
sections.apply:
1. Call 207-942-8322 during posted intake hours: Monday noon–2:30 p.m., Tuesday or Thursday 9–11:30 a.m.
  2. For an office visit, check current walk-in hours and closures before traveling.
  3. Request a free interpreter if needed and complete intake.
sections.after: Confirm what help is offered and any next contact. Keep meeting deadlines while awaiting acceptance. If the organization cannot help, ask for a referral or self-help information relevant to the problem.

faqs: Can I ask for an interpreter?
Yes. Pine Tree provides interpreters without a fee. Ask immediately when you call or arrive.
Can I visit any office at any time?
No. Walk-in hours vary and current closures are posted on the contact page. Check before traveling.
Can it help challenge a benefits decision?
Benefits issues are among its civil practice areas, subject to eligibility and case acceptance. Bring the notice and deadline.
Does it handle an ordinary divorce call?
The current intake page says general family-law calls are not taken. Some abuse-related family matters use referrals through local advocacy organizations.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
